claim: Adds governing-equation or other first-principles residual penalties to diffusion model training for physical outputs.
claim_zh: 在扩散模型训练中加入控制方程或第一性原理残差约束，提高生成样本的物理相容性。
innovation_detail: Adds governing-equation or other first-principles residual penalties to diffusion model training for physical outputs.
innovation_detail_zh: 在扩散模型训练中加入控制方程或第一性原理残差约束，提高生成样本的物理相容性。
bottleneck: Conventional diffusion objectives do not explicitly enforce conservation laws or physical PDE constraints.
bottleneck_zh: 常规扩散训练目标并不直接保证守恒规律与PDE约束得到满足。
tradeoff: Soft physical losses require weighting and do not establish exact physical validity.
